novel_features.name: Cross-tenant fan-out runner
novel_features.description: Run any CIPP endpoint across every client tenant at once and save the results locally.

novel_features.name: Cross-tenant posture matrix
novel_features.description: One tenant-by-metric table of MFA, Conditional Access, Standards, BPA, DLP, retention and sensitivity-label posture from the local store.

novel_features.name: Standards drift report
novel_features.description: Show every tenant whose Standards baseline regressed between two stored snapshots; --since picks the base snapshot.

novel_features.name: Throttle-aware bulk executor
novel_features.description: Drive user and mailbox mutations from a CSV with Retry-After backoff, per-row resume, and honest failure detection.

novel_features.name: License waste reconciler
novel_features.description: Total reclaimable licenses by SKU or by holder from stored users, licenses and CSP licenses.

novel_features.name: Conditional Access cross-tenant diff
novel_features.description: Find which tenants deviate from the Conditional Access baseline the rest of the fleet shares.

novel_features.name: GDAP expiry and coverage sweep
novel_features.description: List delegated-admin relationships expiring inside a window, plus tenants with no active relationship at all.

novel_features.name: Stale account sweep
novel_features.description: List enabled, licensed accounts with no sign-in in N days from the stored users rows.

novel_features.name: Offboarding leftover check
novel_features.description: Find disabled accounts that still hold mail forwarding, inbox rules, directory roles or licenses.

novel_features.name: Snapshot change feed
novel_features.description: Show rows of any stored resource added, removed or modified between two fanout snapshots.

novel_features.name: One-tenant scorecard
novel_features.description: Every stored signal about one tenant in a single record, each with the time its data was saved.
